menu_savings_frame_v2_initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent game HUD frame, one illustrated savings instrument.
Edit target: the supplied brass-and-glass savings tube. Keep its warm polished antique brass, dark navy accents, wood, soft sculptural storybook-game illustration and front-facing perspective. Redesign it as ONE coherent vertical instrument with integrated native-text panels: a blank pale cream wooden/parchment label panel built into the top cap, and a second blank pale cream panel built into the wider bottom base. The lower blank writing area must comfortably fit a short numerical phrase later, but DO NOT draw letters or numbers. Keep restrained brass detailing outside the empty label centers.
Composition: portrait canvas exactly 2:3. Whole object centered, complete silhouette, thin transparent outer margins. Top blank panel approximately x18%-82%, y5%-16%; bottom blank panel approximately x12%-88%, y83%-95%. Broad central hollow window approximately x18%-82%, y21%-79%, wide enough for two or three separate stacks of coins later. Thin glass edge strips/brass uprights only along the sides. The central opening MUST BE COMPLETELY EMPTY AND TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, including its entire center; no colored glass sheet, reflections, brown fill, haze, blur, shadow or glow inside it. It is a cutout overlay that the game will draw coins behind. Likewise all area outside the object must be truly transparent, no scene or floor shadow.
Constraints: no coins, no stacks, no writing, no symbols in either blank panel, no detached floating labels, no ruler markings, no progress bar. Not an hourglass with a narrow waist. Crisp legible silhouette for a 100px wide mobile HUD.

menu_savings_coin_flat:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent horizontal coin sprite for repeating in vertical stacks inside a game UI.
Edit target: the supplied vivid green coin with an embossed gold five-point star. Preserve the recognizable green upper face, single gold star, polished illustrated 3D storybook-game style and color identity, but change the viewpoint and orientation: the coin lies FLAT HORIZONTALLY like a real coin resting on a tabletop, viewed from an elevation of about 30 degrees. Its top is a broad perspective ellipse, not a face-on upright circle. Show a THIN golden rim/edge beneath the elliptical green face, roughly 6%-9% of the coin's width in physical thickness. Ellipse top height about 45%-50% of its width. The gold star is embossed only subtly so repeating coins can sit flat on each other; do not make the star a tall pyramidal lump. Front-facing symmetric horizontal long axis, no left-right roll or tilt. One single coin, complete and centered, occupying most of a wide landscape 2:1 canvas with modest transparent margins.
Lighting: gentle warm upper-left highlights, clean contours and readable green/gold layers. Output REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the single coin. No floor plane, drop shadow, background, checkerboard, extra coins, stack, text, digits or frame. This must be a newly rendered horizontal thin coin, not a vertically squashed version of the source image.
